monitoring.refreshFailed: Last refresh failed. Showing the result from {time}.
monitoring.noneLive: Nothing live. Is the process running?
monitoring.notExpected: Off: its env flag is not set
monitoring.redisUnread: Can't read this while Redis is unreachable: heartbeats and passes are kept there.

users.noneMatchHint: Remove a filter, or try another part of the name or address.
users.newUserHint: Leave the password empty to email them an invite with a link to set one.
users.initialPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Empty: they get an invite instead.
users.invited: Invited {email}. They get a link to set a password.
users.notFoundHint: It may have been mistyped, or the link is from another installation.
users.renameHint: The name shown beside their pages, comments and reviews.
users.setPasswordHint: It signs them out everywhere and emails them that the password changed. Their API keys keep working.
users.passwordSet: Password set. {name} is signed out everywhere.
users.makeAdminBody: A platform admin can open every workspace as its admin and runs this console.
users.adminRevoked: {name} is no longer a platform admin
users.disableBody: They are signed out everywhere and their API keys stop working until the account is enabled again. Nothing they wrote is removed.
users.selfNote: This is your account: you can't disable it or revoke your own platform admin.
users.noWorkspacesLong: Not a member of any workspace.
users.sessionsHint: Where they are signed in. A signed-out session has to log in again on its next request; API keys keep working.
users.revokeAllBody: Every browser and device they use has to log in again. Their API keys keep working.
